Crochet Balloon Dog Pattern is HERE! 🐶🎈 Thank you all so much for your patience — this one took a while to perfect, and I’m so excited to finally share it with you! HOW IT WORKS You’ll crochet the pieces, shape each one over a latex balloon with fabric stiffener, sew them together and reinforce the joints with fabric stiffener again. The full process — shaping, stiffening & assembly — is shown in a video tutorial included with the pattern. WHAT’S INCLUDED ✔ Step-by-step written instructions ✔ Stitch charts ✔ Video tutorial (shaping, stiffening & assembly) ✔ Materials list + fabric stiffener recommendations & alternatives SKILLS NEEDED 🧶 Crochet — Confident Beginner / Intermediate 🪡 Sewing — Basic 🎈 Balloon twisting — no prior experience needed, a short YT tutorial beforehand is enough! Ch 17 (or another odd # of your choosing), hold your place, ch5 more, dc into the 17th chain that you’re holding (or whatever odd # you chose), ch1, skip a chain and dc into the 2nd stitch, ch1, skip a chain and dc into the second stitch. Continue till the end. Ch1 and turn, dc into the first stitch. Ch1, skip the space & dc into the next stitch. Ch1, skip the space & dc into the next stitch. Continue till the end. Repeat this row until desired length.   #crochetscarf #crochetheadband #crochettutorial #crochet #freecrochetpattern
